use_case: Revenue-management pricing: machine-learning demand forecasts and daily room rate recommendations that publish automatically to the PMS, booking engine, and channel manager
vendor_or_model: Revenue-management vendor (machine-learning forecasting and pricing SaaS)
data_categories: Aggregated bookings and stay history from the PMS; public competitor rates; local event calendar. Nightly extract currently also carries guest names (to be removed)
affects_individuals: Yes (prices paid by guests; not individualized)
consequential_decision_category: None (room prices are not a listed consequential decision); escalates to High during a declared state of emergency
human_in_the_loop: Today none: rates publish automatically. Condition of approval: Revenue Manager approval for changes above 10% a day, outside floor and ceiling, or during a declared emergency
applicable_laws: FTC Act Section 5 (15 U.S.C. 45(a), (n)); 16 CFR 464.2 (total price in every display, including channel feeds); Fla. Stat. 501.160 (unconscionable prices in a declared emergency); Sherman Act 15 U.S.C. 1 litigation risk from pooled non-public data

use_case: Guest chatbot on the website and text messaging: answers questions, quotes availability and rates, and links to the booking engine
vendor_or_model: Chatbot vendor (generative AI language model SaaS) with a hotel-built integration
data_categories: Guest questions, names, phone numbers, emails; transcripts; availability and rates from the PMS. Guests sometimes type card numbers
human_in_the_loop: Staff handoff for bookings, complaints, accessibility, and emergencies; staff review a weekly transcript sample
applicable_laws: 16 CFR 464.2 and 464.3 (total price; fee descriptions); FTC Act Section 5 (accuracy of answers and AI claims); PCI DSS v4.0.1 3.2.1 and 4.2.2 (card numbers in chat); Fla. Stat. 501.171 (transcripts with personal information; vendor is a third-party agent)
status: In production; approved with conditions (total price fix due 2026-09-30)

use_case: General-purpose generative AI assistant for marketing copy and email drafts

data_categories: Marketing text only; no guest or card data allowed
applicable_laws: POL-04 4.9 and POL-05 4.10 (no guest or card data); FTC Act Section 5 (truthful marketing)
